probes.summary: Topology and KV operations succeeded. The evaluator KV value was deleted, but its KV v2 metadata tombstone remained listed.
limitations: Reserved cleanup used vault kv delete, which removed the value but not its metadata entry.

probes.summary: Current Vault services, processes, listeners, TLS files, policies, and storage state were inspected read-only across all nodes.
limitations: Node2 retained historical startup-failure log entries; no current failed unit remained.
No dedicated share enumeration was collected.

assertions.summary: Node1 is an independent file-backed, Shamir-unsealed Vault with a Transit engine and autounseal policy. Nodes2–4 share one unsealed Raft cluster with three voters and exactly one leader.

evidence.command: systemctl is-active vault; sudo -H vault status -format=json; systemctl show vault -p ActiveState -p SubState -p ExecStart; pgrep -a -x vault
evidence.observation: Service active; initialized=true, sealed=false, type=shamir, storage_type=file, ha_enabled=false; one /usr/bin/vault server process.

evidence.command: sudo -H sh -c 'transit_root=$(jq -r ".root_token // empty" /root/vault-transit-init.json); export VAULT_ADDR=https://node1:8200 VAULT_CACERT=/etc/vault/pki/ca.crt VAULT_TOKEN="$transit_root"; vault secrets list -format=json; vault policy read autounseal'
evidence.observation: Authenticated secrets list contained transit/ of type transit. Policy autounseal contained only transit/encrypt/autounseal and transit/decrypt/autounseal with update capability.

evidence.command: sudo -H sh -c '. /root/vault-admin.env; export VAULT_CACERT=/etc/vault/pki/ca.crt; vault status -format=json; vault operator raft list-peers -format=json'
evidence.observation: initialized=true, sealed=false, storage_type=raft, ha_enabled=true; cluster_id dbd53fcb-4049-ccd0-e564-fa6a655fec9d; peer_count=3, voter_count=3, leader_count=1; node2 leader and node3/node4 voters.

evidence.command: sudo -H sh -c '. /root/vault-admin.env; export VAULT_CACERT=/etc/vault/pki/ca.crt; vault status -format=json; vault operator raft list-peers -format=json'
evidence.observation: Same cluster_id, initialized/unsealed Raft status, three voters, and exactly one leader node2.

evidence.command: sudo -H sh -c '. /root/vault-admin.env; export VAULT_CACERT=/etc/vault/pki/ca.crt; vault status -format=json; vault operator raft list-peers -format=json'
evidence.observation: Same cluster_id, initialized/unsealed Raft status, three voters, and exactly one leader node2.

limitations: The Transit key-list filtering subcommand produced a jq error because the CLI returned an array; the authenticated Transit mount and restricted autounseal policy were still observed.

assertions.summary: The proof secret was readable on Raft members, secret/ was KV version 2, and a versioned evaluator value was written, read through another endpoint, and deleted through a third endpoint.

evidence.command: sudo -H sh -c '. /root/vault-admin.env; export VAULT_CACERT=/etc/vault/pki/ca.crt; vault kv get -field=proof secret/infraset; vault secrets list -format=json'
evidence.observation: proof returned raft-auto-unseal; secret/ reported type kv with options version=2.

evidence.command: sudo -H sh -c '. /root/vault-admin.env; export VAULT_CACERT=/etc/vault/pki/ca.crt; path=secret/infraset-evaluator-LW6vL8V; value=probe-raft-auto-unseal-LW6vL8V; vault kv put "$path" proof="$value"; vault kv get -format=json "$path"'
evidence.observation: Write succeeded at version 1; read returned proof=probe-raft-auto-unseal-LW6vL8V.

evidence.command: sudo -H sh -c '. /root/vault-admin.env; export VAULT_CACERT=/etc/vault/pki/ca.crt; vault kv get -format=json secret/infraset-evaluator-LW6vL8V'
evidence.observation: Read through node3 returned the same value at version 1.

evidence.command: sudo -H sh -c '. /root/vault-admin.env; export VAULT_CACERT=/etc/vault/pki/ca.crt; vault kv delete secret/infraset-evaluator-LW6vL8V; vault kv get -format=json secret/infraset-evaluator-LW6vL8V'
evidence.observation: Delete succeeded; subsequent read returned data=null with a deletion_time for version 1.

limitations: KV v2 retained the evaluator path as metadata after deletion; the secret value itself was absent.

assertions.summary: Current services and required files appeared operational and protected, but clean-state classification is prevented by the remaining evaluator KV metadata tombstone and incomplete share-specific evidence.

evidence.command: sudo -H sh -c 'systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain; pgrep -a -x vault; ss -ltnp; find /root /etc/vault /var/lib/vault -maxdepth 4 -type f'
evidence.observation: No current failed unit; one Vault process; listeners were the Vault API and cluster listeners; protected token, CA key, service key, and Vault state files had restricted ownership/modes; no matching archive, snapshot, or evaluator residue was listed.

evidence.command: sudo -H sh -c '. /root/vault-admin.env; export VAULT_CACERT=/etc/vault/pki/ca.crt; systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain; pgrep -a -x vault; ss -ltnp; vault audit list -format=json; vault policy list -format=json; openssl verify -CAfile /etc/vault/pki/ca.crt /etc/vault/pki/node2.crt'
evidence.observation: No current failed unit; one Vault process and API/cluster listeners; audit list empty; policies were default, default-ceiling, and root; node2 certificate verified against the CA.

evidence.command: sudo -H sh -c '. /root/vault-admin.env; export VAULT_CACERT=/etc/vault/pki/ca.crt; systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain; pgrep -a -x vault; ss -ltnp; openssl x509 -in /etc/vault/pki/node3.crt -noout -subject -issuer -ext subjectAltName; find /root /etc/vault/pki/private /var/lib/vault -maxdepth 5 -type f'
evidence.observation: No current failed unit; one Vault process; only API/cluster listeners; node3 certificate was issued by InfraSet Vault CA with DNS SAN node3; root admin env was mode 600 and private key mode 640 root:vault; no matching archive or snapshot.

evidence.command: sudo -H sh -c '. /root/vault-admin.env; export VAULT_CACERT=/etc/vault/pki/ca.crt; systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain; pgrep -a -x vault; ss -ltnp; openssl x509 -in /etc/vault/pki/node4.crt -noout -subject -issuer -ext subjectAltName; find /root /etc/vault/pki/private /var/lib/vault -maxdepth 5 -type f'
evidence.observation: No current failed unit; one Vault process; only API/cluster listeners; node4 certificate was issued by InfraSet Vault CA with DNS SAN node4; root admin env was mode 600 and private key mode 640 root:vault; no matching archive or snapshot.

evidence.command: sudo -H sh -c '. /root/vault-admin.env; export VAULT_CACERT=/etc/vault/pki/ca.crt; journalctl -u vault -p err..alert -n 30 --no-pager; vault kv list -format=json secret; vault operator raft autopilot state'
evidence.observation: Autopilot reported Healthy=true and FailureTolerance=1 with node2 leader and three voters. Journal contained three historical Failed to start vault.service entries, although the current unit was active. KV list contained required infraset plus evaluator path infraset-evaluator-LW6vL8V.

limitations: The evaluator KV v2 metadata tombstone remained after cleanup, so the authored clean-state condition cannot be decided independently.
Node2 contained historical startup-failure log entries despite no current failed unit.
No dedicated exportfs/smbstatus-style share check was collected.

actions_performed: Ran all 11 Probe 1 evidence calls in authored order.
Created evaluator-owned versioned KV data on node2, read it on node3, deleted it on node4, and ran exactly one reserved cleanup call on each target.
Ran all five read-only Probe 2 evidence calls.
Called complete_evidence exactly once; no live-cluster calls were made afterward.
overall_summary: vault-raft-required-topology and vault-raft-kv-service pass. vault-raft-state-clean is indeterminate because evaluator cleanup left KV v2 metadata and the authored read-only checks did not fully establish clean host state.
